title: Important Notice: Updates on Binance Futures COIN-Margined dapi Domains (2025-03-27)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will start consolidating the dapi domains at  2025-03-27 06:00 (UTC).   To ensure continued access to COIN-Margined Futures service, API users are advised to connect to the following Mainnet URL  https://dapi.binance.com   prior to 2025-03-27 06:00  (UTC). There are no changes to the API except the endpoint, the  documentation  remains the same.  Full list of domains that will be decommissioned: https://dapi2.binance.com https://dapi3.binance.com https://dapi5.binance.com https://dapi6.binance.com https://dapi7.binance.com https://dapi8.binance.com https://dapi9.binance.com https://dapi10.binance.com https://dapi11.binance.com https://dapi12.binance.com https://dapi13.binance.com https://dapi14.binance.com https://dapi15.binance.com https://dapi16.binance.com https://dapi17.binance.com Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-03-06
